title: IIRC: A Dataset of Incomplete Information Reading Comprehension Questions
reasoning: The paper introduces a new reading comprehension dataset derived from Wikipedia. While the source text may contain passages related to religion, such as the example about Friedrich Max Müller founding the 'comparative study of religions', the paper's core contribution, methodology, and evaluation are focused on the technical challenge of question answering with incomplete information. There is no component that evaluates or benchmarks religion, morals, or ethics.
